title: Gym Selfie with Peony
description: A young woman with black hair and white headphones stands in a gym wearing a white and red sports bra and red shorts, holding a selfie stick with a smartphone. She poses beside an enormous, vividly detailed purple peony flower with orange center and red leaves that dominates the right side of the frame.
prompt: A fit young East Asian woman with black hair wearing white over-ear headphones, white and red sports bra and red shorts stands in a gym surrounded by dumbbells and equipment. She holds a selfie stick with a smartphone showing her face on screen, confidently posing with one hand on her hip. To her right is a giant vibrant purple peony flower with detailed orange center and reddish leaves, surreal blend of realistic gym interior and oversized botanical element, cinematic lighting.
